title: GainComputer and GainSmoother — hard/soft/expander laws, curve shape, per-band
description:
Implement Source/DSP/GainComputer and Source/DSP/GainSmoother for target-gain laws and per-band open/close smoothing (realtime-safe).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md sections 15 (hard/soft/expander, floor, curve shape gamma) and 16 (per-band open/close alphas)
- Source/DSP/PerformanceStateMachine.* public state/certainty API from c.1 if present (consume conceptually; do not edit it)
- Existing Source/DSP/ conventions for prepare/reset/process

Implement GainComputer.h/.cpp:
- Modes: hard gate, soft gate, downward expander.
- Hard: target snaps between unity and floor under digital open/close evidence.
- Soft: transition spread across threshold knee / open certainty (compatible with section 7.3 soft region when supplied).
- Downward expander: G_exp_dB = max(G_floor_dB, (R-1)*(L-T)) for R > 1; linear gain from dB.
- Floor: g_floor = 10^(G_floor_dB/20) covering 0 dB through about −80 dB.
- Curve shape: g_shaped = g_floor + (1-g_floor) * S^gamma with gamma <1 Natural, =1 Firm, >1 Clamp; S is open/amount in [0,1].
- Inputs: detector level L (dB), threshold T, ratio R where needed, floor, gamma, optional open certainty / state hints from the performance engine. Output: linear target gain G*.

Implement GainSmoother.h/.cpp:
- Per-band (or N-band array) smoothing with separate open/close constants per section 16:
  alpha = exp(-1/(fs*tau_open)) when G* > Gprev; else exp(-1/(fs*tau_close))
  G[n] = alpha*G[n-1] + (1-alpha)*G*[n]
- Support at least full-band (1) and multi-band channel counts needed by later Dual/Tri modes (e.g. up to 3 bands) without implementing crossovers.
- prepare(sampleRate, numBands)/reset(); process target gains → smoothed gains. Realtime-safe.
- Reopen continuity: when targets reverse during release, smoother must not force G to 0 — one-pole toward new target only.

Do NOT edit PerformanceStateMachine. Do NOT edit CMakeLists.txt or PluginProcessor (c.3). Do NOT write tests (c.4).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: GainComputer implements hard gate, soft gate, and downward expander laws
Downward expander uses G_exp_dB = max(G_floor_dB, (R-1)*(L-T)) with R > 1
GainComputer applies floor g_floor = 10^(G_floor_dB/20) and curve shape g_shaped = g_floor + (1-g_floor)*S^gamma
GainSmoother uses separate open/close alphas alpha=exp(-1/(fs*tau)) and G[n]=alpha*G[n-1]+(1-alpha)*G*[n]
GainSmoother supports per-band open/close time constants for at least one and multiple bands
No heap allocation in the per-block process path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement multiband crossovers or Hiss Curtain filters

allowed: use plain C++20 + JUCE types already in the project
define GainMode enum and fixed-size per-band state arrays (no heap in process)
accept open-certainty / PerformanceState as optional inputs without owning the state machine
forbidden: implement LR4 crossovers or spectral split here
